observation_origin: Fresh actual local Compose capture per batch; no fault injection and no claim of clean normal controls
capture: 8 checkout probes, 20s settle, fixed 20 source/service snapshots; failures retained
storage: Shared isolated PostgreSQL, official checkpoints, exact per-Incident Evidence/report/trace ownership
resource_scope: Batch elapsed, process CPU and Python heap; per-case elapsed and SQL lease queue waits; excludes capture/bootstrap/provider/container resources
authority: No approval decisions or execution; Pending allowed only through existing guarded Policy path
scoring: Resource/integration experiment, no retrospective root-cause scoring; one small batch per concurrency, no capacity or human savings claim
